605:t_044:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And that goes all the way back to when humanity first set foot on the Moon...」

605:t_044:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Why would those guys do something like that?」

605:t_044:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「The only way to get that answer is to ask them directly.」

605:t_044:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So none of you have despaired.」

605:t_044:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「To be honest, I'm scared... The scale of our opponent, its power, its purpose, all of it is far beyond what we imagined.」

605:t_044:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Maybe that was true in the old days, but if they think they can keep us as pets forever, we'll show them they're dead wrong!」

605:t_044:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity's evolution isn't ours to decide... But if someone stands in its way, we'll fight that existence with everything we have.」

605:t_044:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Those who block the future... are our enemy.」

605:t_044:10.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Now that $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has been wiped out, our destination is $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

605:t_044:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's different from back then. This time, we'll win.」

605:t_044:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone... hasn't changed... No... you've grown stronger than before.」

605:t_044:13.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A lot has happened to us, too.」

605:t_044:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Tell me everything that happened while I was gone... okay, $n?」

605:t_044:18.en:
$n
($$アサキム$$, who cannot die... Advent, who comes back even after vanishing...)

605:t_044:19.en:
$n
(That power... Does it have something to do with my turning back time...?)

605:t_045:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「So this is as far as I go...!」

605:t_045:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait, $$ブルー$$! Just how much do you know about $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

605:t_045:2.en:
$$ブルー$$
「The Captain is the one who guides us... We will eliminate anyone who interferes with his purpose.」

605:t_045:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I hope you will all reconsider.」

605:t_046:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What is with that guy...? Does he really believe in $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ from the bottom of his heart...?」

605:t_047:1.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Nothing you say will do any good, $n. As long as you're the Captain's enemy, you're my enemy.」

605:t_048:2.en:
$n
「...I'm all right, Miss $$スズネ$$... I... can fight.」

605:t_048:3.en:
$n
($$マキ#pilot$$... Even if you're the one I'm up against...)

605:t_049:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Not bad, $n. Looks like you've shaken off that business with your mom.」

605:t_049:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Sorry about that. The moment you took the $$スフィア$$ from me, our hearts linked up for a split second, it seems.」

605:t_049:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Thanks to that, I ended up learning about this so-called root of despair inside you.」

605:t_049:4.en:
$n
「...Is that all you have to say?」

605:t_049:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Cut it out. I'm not looking to fight you right now.」

605:t_049:6.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(Judging by that look, he still hasn't completely gotten over it...)

605:t_049:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
(Now, will this turn out for better or for worse...)

605:t_100:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Shall we have our final showdown, $n?」

605:t_100:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What's wrong? Aren't you going to say it like always? 'I'll take Miss $$スズネ$$ back!'...」

605:t_100:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Given up? Even the man who rises above hope and despair seems to have realized he's lost.」

605:t_100:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then I'll be taking $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! That wraps everything up!」

605:t_100:6.en:
$n
「...Come on, $$アムブリエル$$...! I'm telling you now, I haven't given up one bit!」

605:t_100:7.en:
$n
「First, I stop you! Everything else comes after that!」

605:t_101:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... As I thought, you're wonderful.」

605:t_101:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Meeting a person like you is one of the most joyful things that has happened to me.」

605:t_101:3.en:
$n
「Don't mess with me! I'm not your property!」

605:t_101:4.en:
$n
「I have no more doubts! You shot Miss $$スズネ$$, so you're my enemy!!」

605:t_102:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I understand, $$セツコ$$... You're sad that it came to fighting me.」

605:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But I'll overcome the sadness...! And the hesitation and dread in my heart, too!」

605:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Sadness makes you stronger... It seems $$アサキム$$'s way was the right one after all.」

605:t_102:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then in his place, I will take on the role of giving you even more sadness.」

605:t_103:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can't believe it came to this after all...!」

605:t_103:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is different from our last battle... You endure the doubt and guilt within you and come at me, don't you?」

605:t_103:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Maybe... But there's a feeling in me that's stronger than that... Anger at you!」

605:t_103:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've got an excuse, hurry up and say it! Otherwise, I'm seriously gonna punch you!」

605:t_103:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Good. It's a full 100% of your strength that I want.」

605:t_104:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This turned out to be a result I'm not happy about.」

605:t_104:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even as you say that, I'd say you sensed this day coming somewhere inside, ever since you acted with me on $$翠の地球$$.」

605:t_104:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You see right through me, huh...」

605:t_104:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your strong will sustains your intuition. It was decided from the moment we met that we would end up like this.」

605:t_104:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Use your words precisely. You're the one who decided it anyway, aren't you?」

605:t_104:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You truly are frightening. I'll let you show me how far that power can grow.」

605:t_105:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So it came to this... It's a shame, $$アサキム$$.」

605:t_105:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You and I shared the same goal...」

605:t_105:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But more than that fact, I cannot forgive your very existence.」

605:t_105:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's fine. Live freely.」

605:t_105:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Live... What an empty word.」

605:t_106:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I came back to pay you back what I owe you!」

605:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Venting your anger at me is misdirected, you know.」

605:t_106:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Making excuses at a time like this!」

605:t_106:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Very well, $$ガドライト#pilot$$. If it will satisfy you, I will accept those feelings.」

605:t_106:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That too is probably my duty.」

605:t_106:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「That composure ends here! Get ready!」
